additional_info.subject: case notes
additional_info.body:
Vi har återkommande problem med att laddarens dörr registreras som öppen, vilket medför att enheten går offline och därmed blir obrukbar för kunderna. Vi har vid flera tillfällen varit på plats och manuellt öppnat och stängt dörren, vilket tillfälligt löser problemet, men detta är inte en hållbar driftlösning.
Vi behöver därför en permanent åtgärd eller teknisk lösning som säkerställer att dörrens sensor eller låsmekanism fungerar korrekt och inte orsakar oplanerade driftstopp.
Återkom gärna med förslag på åtgärder, felsökningssteg eller komponenter som kan behöva bytas ut för att säkerställa stabil funktion.
Serienummer: Y2/S3313581528002
Plats: Lomma, Laddpunkt 1-4

additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0466314
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-SE SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/S3 313581528002
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following the report from our client regarding BG3 and BG4, and after confirming that the problem is not related to the door open issue, we would like you to check the 24V circuit of BG3 and BG4.
Please measure between terminals
21 and 22
, as well as
XD09 and XD34
.
If you observe any voltage drop, please proceed with the replacement.
-
3SE5232-0HC05 -BG3, -BG4 Door Position Switch 1x NO / 1x NC
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-SE
SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
